assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry study is 93229.
The diagnostic procedure was appropriately authorized and performed.
The required precertification was not obtained prior to the service date.
The service resulted in denial under Reason Code CO-197.
The clinical indication note documents the exact symptoms and the rationale for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service supports the medical necessity of this service under the patient's covered diagnostic benefits.
